integrity: Proof gives an infinite-parameter argument from complete residue order-statistic bounds; finite tests are corroboration, not a substitute. Full independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers \(a\ge5\), \(2\le d\le\lfloor a/2\rfloor\), \(\gcd(a,d)=1\), the levels \(\lfloor a/2\rfloor+2\le p\le a+d\), and exactly the first successor. No claim for other levels or steps. An implicit equivalent in general restricted-partition literature remains possible.
title: A sharp affine \(p\)-Frobenius phase for three-term arithmetic progressions
